images.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Generate a square photorealistic catalog image of a proposed custom FIVE-SIDED THERMAL PALLET HOOD. Reference image is ONLY the company's silver foil-faced white flexible foam material: use its fine irregular embossed foil texture, do not copy measuring instrument, numeric thickness or hand. Product design: a simple silver flexible rectangular hood with closed flat top and four continuous sides, open bottom; no zips, no handles, no straps, no logos. Hood slips over a neatly cuboidal carton load on a plain light wooden pallet. Its lower hem ends at the top of the pallet deck leaving all fork-entry spaces visible; the hood is NOT a rigid box or a box liner. Subtle joined seams run along top perimeter and vertical corners; realistic small wrinkles, flexible layered edge, not woven fabric, not shiny satin or bubble cells. Front three-quarter full view, complete pallet and top within canvas, about 12 percent safe margins. Seamless #F6F6F4 studio background, soft natural photographic light and contact shadow, no words, no labels, no claims, no brand marks. This is a proposed sample construction, not production evidence.
